note: Promotion to the tracked schema is out of scope: K–12's 64 themes each name exactly one row at one single grade (K through 12), not a five-band ladder, so this fills description only through the unbanded mechanism (v0.95.0, prompt 3 continuation) after apply_promotions()'s grade filter was extended from BAND_LEVEL to GRADE_LEVEL to reach single-grade rows. track/code/level stay as they were (LB-<n> codes, level derived structurally by light_fill()).
